answers.core: It's probably easier to update the reflection probe system than to refactor it all out.
answers.workaround:
The current reflection probe system is still perfectly usable. It may or may not perform better depending on the situation.[^w1]
[^w1]:More likely when the number of probes is smaller, when each cubemap has higher resolution, and when the scene has less triangles.
